text:
Alex: Heads-up — I'm planning the nightshift deploy for release v0.9.3 at 23:00 UTC. Canary -> 2 nodes, then 50% traffic after 5m if metrics look good. ETA ~15-25m.
Maria: Ack. I ran the DB migration dry-run in staging earlier today, looks backward compatible. Migration window is 23:05-23:10 (fast), no lock expected.
Sanjay: I'll own the deploy steps and runbook. @Alex can you add the final image tag and canary policy to the rollout config?
Alex: Done — image tag redwood/service:v0.9.3-20260317, rollout policy "night-canary-2" in the ops config.
Lisa: I'm on smoke. Will follow the smoke checklist and validate latency, error rate, and a sample eval set.
Alex: Quick checklist (please ack):
• owners: @Sanjay (deploy), @Lisa (smoke), @Maria (migration)
• prechecks: health dashboards green, queue length < 1000, infra capacity >= 120%
• smoke commands and queries ready
• rollback path validated
• approvals from security if any token changes

Maria: Prechecks done — dashboards green, no active alerts. Queue at 430.
ops-oncall: SRE note — I'll keep an eye on the dgraph replicas during migration window. No maintenance scheduled.
Sanjay: Copy. Rolling through the steps in the runbook. Posting progress here.
Alex: Paste smoke commands below for visibility:
```bash
# quick health
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/health | jq .
# tiny inference sample
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"redwood-v1","input":"hello world"}' | jq .
# run internal smoke harness
python infra/tests/smoke.py --env=prod --model=redwood-v1 --samples=50
```
Lisa: Got it. I'll run the `smoke.py` once canary is at 2 nodes.
Sanjay: Canary deploy started (initiating canary lane). Updating here: canary nodes 2, new pods scheduling.
deploy-bot: canary rollout: 2/2 pods ready, version redwood/service:v0.9.3-20260317.
Lisa: Running smoke now. First 10 samples ✅, avg latency 120ms, p95 210ms, errors 0.
Maria: Migration applied at 23:07, verified schema and row counts. No replication lag.
Alex: After 5m stable metrics we move to 50% traffic. Ops, confirm no infra alarms.
ops-oncall: No infra alarms. Disk I/O nominal, GPU util under expected burst.
Sanjay: Rolling to 50% traffic now.
deploy-bot: rollout: 50% traffic shift complete. Monitoring for 10m.
Lisa: Second smoke batch (50 samples) — small uptick in p95 to 260ms but within SLA. Errors 1/50 (timeout retry). Logging trace id: trace-12345 for the failed sample.
Alex: Noted. Trace id captured. We'll watch for patterns for next 10m.
Sanjay: Proceeding to full rollout if no regression in next 8 minutes. Anyone object?
Maria: No objections from DB side.
Lisa: Fine from smoke side — will continue to monitor.
ops-oncall: I'll pause non-critical infra jobs for the next 30m.
Sanjay: Full rollout initiated.
deploy-bot: rollout: 100% traffic complete. All services reporting version redwood/service:v0.9.3-20260317.
Lisa: Final smoke pass: 200 samples run, p95 stable, error rate 0.3% — within expected.
Alex: Great. Post-deploy tasks:
• tag release in repo: `git tag -a v0.9.3 -m "prod deploy 2026-03-17"`
• update changelog entry in release-notes
• schedule follow-up health check at +4h

Sanjay: Tagging now.
Maria: I'll trigger a quick audit log export for the migration window.
ops-oncall: All good from infra. If anything spikes, ping #incidents and call me.
Lisa: Using checklist: all done ✅. Closing the deploy thread.
Alex: Thanks team — nice smooth nightshift handoff. :tada:
